turns.text: on the 7:02 rn and its packed, standing, holding a large masala chai in one hand so basically one thumb. need a plan to knock out some linkedin alum messages on my phone
One-thumb mode, got it. A few questions so I can fit this to your ride: how long until you get off the train, and roughly how many messages are you hoping to send?
20 min ride. phone battery usually dies by 4 so i cant burn it all on this, keep it short pls. lowkey this heat is free sauna

Then keep it to a tight 20 minutes with minimal screen time:

**Minutes 0-3:** Open LinkedIn and pick 3 alumni to message. Pick them on the spot, don't browse. Lower brightness and turn on battery saver now.

**Minutes 3-6:** Write one reusable template in your notes app and paste it each time. Something like: "Hi [Name], I'm a student at [school] and saw you work in [field] at [company]. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat about how you got started? Thanks either way."

**Minutes 6-16:** Personalize one line per person, like their role or something from their profile, and send. About 3 minutes each, tops.

**Minutes 16-20:** Stop. Put the phone away and finish your chai. Jot the 3 names in your tracker later, when you're at a desk with a charger.

So: 3 messages, about 20 minutes, and a phone that still has juice this afternoon. If you want more, do a second batch at a stop when you're seated instead of stretching this one.
thx. can u make that template one line shorter, my thumb is tired just reading it 💀

Ha, here's the trimmed version:

"Hi [Name], I'm a student at [school] interested in [field]. Could I ask you a couple of quick questions about your path? Thanks either way."

That's short enough to paste and tweak with one thumb. Just swap in the name and field and send.
